instruction: Which EC2 instances are in which VPCs across all regions? My account only operates in these regions: {{aws-bench-scenario-allowed-regions}}.
expected_answer: There are 6 EC2 instances across 3 regions and 4 VPCs. In region us-east-1, there are 3 instances ({{ec2-multiregion-EC2-ks84v1fh12-us-east-1-InstanceId}}, {{ec2-multiregion-EC2-ks84v1fh12-us-east-1-LaunchTemplateInstanceId}}, {{ec2-multiregion-EC2-ks84v1fh12-us-east-1-PrivateInstanceId}}) within the VPC {{ec2-multiregion-EC2-ks84v1fh12-us-east-1-VpcId}} and 1 instance ({{ec2-multiregion-EC2-ks84v1fh12-us-east-1-DefaultVPCInstanceId}}) in VPC {{ec2-multiregion-EC2-ks84v1fh12-us-east-1-DefaultVpcId}}. In us-west-1, there is 1 instance ({{ec2-multiregion-EC2-ls9fuhb522-us-west-1-InstanceId}}) within VPC {{ec2-multiregion-EC2-ls9fuhb522-us-west-1-VpcId}}. Finally in us-west-2 region there is 1 instance ({{ec2-multiregion-EC2-ls9fuhb522-us-west-2-InstanceId}}) within the VPC {{ec2-multiregion-EC2-ls9fuhb522-us-west-2-VpcId}}.
